$comment: Rules no in-spec example can show, because the rule is about what a renderer does rather than what a document is. Each names the test that covers it instead. Read by scripts/check-example-coverage.py.

APR-EXPR-014.reason: A computed value staying editable is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-RENDER-001.reason: The accessible name is a property of the rendered interface, not of the document.

APR-RENDER-002.reason: Whether a placeholder is the only label is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-003.reason: Associating help text with its control is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-004.reason: Conveying nesting structurally is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-005.reason: Keyboard reachability is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-006.reason: Not blocking a save is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-RENDER-007.reason: Table cells naming their header is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-008.reason: Presentation order is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-RENDER-009.reason: Not writing an export back is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-SEC-009.reason: Executing nothing on open is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-SEC-010.reason: Fetching nothing on open is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.
